message: Oh, what a lovely day! I sure like having living relatives!
A mysterious letter has been delivered via Raven

To Whom It Might Probably Concern, At Least A Little:

[hi, have som news of ur relative that ded under mystrs circlesnences, ther nam waz bread, and and also u've inherited ther bakery, iz no trap, promis]
MY EXPECTATIONS ARE SHATTERED AND MY DAY IS RUINED!!!!

Wait I don't remember having a relative named bread.

...

Uncle Bread? Aunt Bread? Great Grand Bread?
Well, I'd better go inherit this bakery! ADVENTURE, HO!
